content.text:
Fixed. `npm test` now passes.

**Cause:** `parseDate` in `src/dates.js` passed the 1-based month from the ISO string straight into `Date.UTC`, which expects a 0-based month. Every parsed date landed one month late. An invoice issued 2026-01-30 with 14-day terms came out due 2026-03-16 instead of 2026-02-13.

**Fix:** `Date.UTC(y, m, d)` is now `Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d)`.

`src/report.js` also calls `parseDate`, so its output was shifted the same way and is corrected by this change. I didn't review that file beyond confirming it uses `parseDate`.

The test suite has only this one case. If you want more coverage, a year-boundary case (for example, issued Dec 20) would be a good addition.
